name: Acid Storage Tank – Skid Mounted
summary: Circular-shell skid-mounted tank for acid and chemical storage up to 34% HCL, built to ASTM A-36.
description: Spec content moved here from the old site's Caravan Manufacturing page, where it had been misfiled — this is a tank product, not a caravan.
specs: Shell: 6mm thick HR steel plate to ASTM A-36 or equivalent, fully welded staggered joints
2 shallow-drawn dish heads (8mm), mounted on heavy-duty skid frame
GMAW welding using ACM gas for bead appearance, penetration and strength
Coating: Derakane 411-45 laminate system — 3 matting layers + tissue + gel/wax coat (E-glass chopped strand mat 600gsm ×2 + 450gsm ×1)
Medium: acid/chemical storage up to 34% HCL
Piping: 4" inlet with PTFE-lined BF valve & hammer union (Fig 206 thread); 4" discharge manifold with PTFE-lined BF valves, 2× 4" Fig 206 female discharge connections
Surface treatment: sandblasted inside & outside to SA2.5
